diagnosis: `induction der` fails because the typing derivation is indexed by the fixed context `[]`. Generalizing that context first makes the index a variable; the resulting equality lets `grind` eliminate impossible cases and apply the induction hypotheses.
proof_body:
by
  generalize hΓ : ([] : Context Var) = Γ at der
  induction der <;>
    grind [cases Term.Value, cases Red, Sub.refl, Typing.abs_inv,
      Typing.tabs_inv, Typing.inl_inv, Typing.inr_inv]
